title: Norisoboldine suppresses epithelial-mesenchymal transition in colorectal cancer by simultaneously inhibiting the CXCR4/CXCR7 chemokine receptors and the JAK/STAT3 signaling pathway.
authors: Kim, Na Young; Hong, Yejin; Baek, Seung Ho; Nam, Dongwoo; Le, Ducdat; Lee, Mina; Um, Jae-Young; Ahn, Kwang Seok
journal: The Journal of pharmacy and pharmacology
one_liner_zh: 研究天然化合物NOR通过抑制JAK/STAT3信号通路及趋化因子受体影响结直肠癌上皮间质转化，仅含初步分子对接，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: Norisoboldine (NOR), an isoquinoline alkaloid from Radix Linderae, has known anti-inflammatory properties, but its role in colorectal cancer remains unclear. METHODS: HCT-15, SW480, and HT-29 cells were treated with NOR and assessed via MTT, Western blotting, zymography, wound-healing, invasion assays, and STAT3 loss/gain-of-function experiments. Molecular docking explored NOR-STAT3 interaction. KEY FINDINGS: NOR showed limited cytotoxicity at the concentrations used for mechanistic experiments. NOR decreased the expression of mesenchymal and metastasis-associated proteins, including Vimentin, Twist, Snail, CXCR4, CXCR7, MMP-2, and MMP-9, while increasing E-cadherin and Occludin levels. NOR also reduced gelatinolytic activity and attenuated CXCL12-enhanced migration and invasion. In parallel, NOR decreased phosphorylation of STAT3 and its upstream kinases JAK1, JAK2, and Src, and reduced nuclear accumulation of STAT3. STAT3 knockdown lowered CXCR4, CXCR7, and Snail expression, whereas STAT3 overexpression produced the opposite pattern; NOR partly reversed these changes. Docking analysis suggested that NOR may interact with the SH2 domain of STAT3, although this requires biochemical validation. CONCLUSION: NOR attenuates epithelial-mesenchymal transition and invasive phenotypes in colorectal cancer cells via JAK/STAT3 suppression, positioning it as a candidate anti-metastatic modulator. Further in vivo and target-engagement studies are warranted.
abstract_zh: 目的：诺利索定（NOR）是从乌药（Radix Linderae）中提取的一种异喹啉生物碱，已知具有抗炎特性，但其在结直肠癌中的作用仍不清楚。方法：用NOR处理HCT-15、SW480和HT-29细胞，并通过MTT、Western blotting、酶谱法、伤口愈合、侵袭实验及STAT3功能缺失/获得实验进行评估。分子对接探索了NOR与STAT3的相互作用。主要发现：在用于机制实验的浓度下，NOR显示出有限的细胞毒性。NOR降低了间充质和转移相关蛋白的表达，包括Vimentin、Twist、Snail、CXCR4、CXCR7、MMP-2和MMP-9，同时增加了E-cadherin和Occludin的水平。NOR还降低了明胶酶活性，并减弱了CXCL12增强的迁移和侵袭。同时，NOR降低了STAT3及其上游激酶JAK1、JAK2和Src的磷酸化，并减少了STAT3的核积累。STAT3敲低降低了CXCR4、CXCR7和Snail的表达，而STAT3过表达则产生相反模式；NOR部分逆转了这些变化。对接分析提示NOR可能与STAT3的SH2结构域相互作用，尽管这需要生化验证。结论：NOR通过抑制JAK/STAT3信号通路减弱结直肠癌细胞的上皮-间质转化和侵袭表型，使其成为潜在的抗转移调节剂。进一步的体内和靶点结合研究是必要的。
